name: Mugenrou to Nemurenu Chou
source:
You are suffering from insomnia, you light a mysterious incense for sleep well. 

In your dream, you come across a red-light district where demons and humans gather. 

A man offers himself gives you a hot and unforgettable night... 

This is a story about “love and lust” that is like a dream.

[From [url=https://ikemenfangirl.tumblr.com/post/769109633959870464/mugenro-to-nemure-nu-chou-adult-otome-game]Ikemen Fangirl[/url]]
translation:
你失眠了，你点燃神秘的香，让自己睡个好觉。

在梦中，你遇到了恶魔和人类聚集的红灯区。

一个男人愿意给你一个炎热而难忘的夜晚…… 

这是一个如梦似幻的关于“爱与欲”的故事。

[来自[url=https://ikemenfangirl.tumblr.com/post/769109633959870464/mugenro-to-nemure-nu-chou-adult-otome-game]Ikemen Fangirl[/url]]
